title: toc
text:
toc

reference

low- & high-res. pseoduobulks
from scRNA-seq reference data

setup

add core-level metadata
write polygons to .parquet
format into SingleCellExperiment
negative & false codes as altExps

filtering

based on cell-level metrics
& distance to FOV borders

signatures

MSigDB, in-house, public
& pan-cancer T cell atlas

signaling

using COMMOT

clustering

semi-supervised for all but stromal
split into NK/T, myeloid stromal & tumor cells

subclustering’’

semi-supervised for all but stromal
subset-specific feature selection

contexts

cluster cells based on composition
of 20um radial neighborhoods

processing

pooling of results into single object
dimensionality reduction (joint & split)

EDA clustering
EDA signatures
EDA signaling

nomenclature

core identifiers = patient + replicate + tissue + group

patient: 01-12; replicate: 1 or 2 if any, 0 otherwise
(e.g., 071 = patient 7, 1st rep; 020 = patient 2, only rep)
tissue:

EY = eye
LN = lymph node
SO = soft tissue
NP = nasopharyngeal

group:

m = mantle
n = nodal
d = diffuse

library(qs)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(patchwork)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")





qs <- list.files("data/ref", "qs$", full.names=TRUE)
names(qs) <- gsub("\\.qs", "", basename(qs))
se <- lapply(qs, \(.) {
    so <- qread(.)
    se <- as.SingleCellExperiment(so)
    logcounts(se) <- NULL
    dr <- tail(reducedDims(se), 1)[[1]]
    reducedDims(se) <- list(UMAP=dr)
    gs <- VariableFeatures(so)
    gs <- rownames(se) %in% gs
    rowData(se)$hvg <- gs
    se
}); sapply(se, dim)

# wrangling
cd <- data.frame(colData(sce))
cd$cpa <- with(cd, nCount_RNA/Area.um2)
df <- cbind(cd, d <- .d2b(cd)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(d))) |>
    mutate(value=value*1e3) |>
    mutate(name=factor(name, 
        c("t", "r", "b", "l"),
        c("top", "right", "bottom", "left")))
fd <- df |>
    group_by(name, value) |>
    summarise_at("cpa", mean) |>
    arrange(value) |> group_by(name) |> mutate(
        mu_x=rollmean(value, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0),
        mu_y=rollmean(cpa, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0)) 
mu <- data.frame(name=unique(fd$name), y=mean(cd$cpa))

    select(where(is.numeric)) |>
    summarise(across(everything(), mean))

# wrangling
cd <- data.frame(colData(sce))
cd$cpa <- with(cd, nCount_RNA/Area.um2)
df <- cbind(cd, d <- .d2b(cd)) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(colnames(d))) |>
    mutate(value=value*1e3) |>
    mutate(name=factor(name, 
        c("t", "r", "b", "l"),
        c("top", "right", "bottom", "left")))
fd <- df |>
    group_by(name, value) |>
    summarise_at("cpa", mean) |>
    arrange(value) |> group_by(name) |> mutate(
        mu_x=rollmean(value, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0),
        mu_y=rollmean(cpa, 20, mean, align="left", fill=0)) 
mu <- data.frame(name=unique(fd$name), y=mean(cd$cpa))
md <- metadata(sub)$ths |>
    select(where(is.numeric)) |>
    summarise(across(everything(), mean))

# plotting
dy <- ceiling(max(fd$mu_y)/0.1)*0.1
ggplot(fd, aes(mu_x, mu_y)) +
    facet_grid(~name) + geom_line(col="navy", linewidth=0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=md$d, col="red", linewidth=0.4, lty=2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=md$a, col="red", linewidth=0.4, lty=2) +
    geom_hline(data=mu, aes(yintercept=y), col="blue", linewidth=0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous("FOV border distance (um)", expand=expansion(0.04)) +
    scale_y_continuous("RNA counts per um", n.breaks=3, expand=expansion(0.06)) +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5)) + .thm_fig("bw") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 60), ylim=c(0, dy))











Code
ex <- !colnames(sce) %in% colnames(sub)
df <- as.data.frame(table(sid=sce$sid, ex))
p0 <- ggplot(df, aes(Freq, sid, fill=ex))
p1 <- p0 + 
    geom_col(position="fill", key_glyph="point") +
    scale_x_continuous("% cells", n.breaks=6) +
    .thm_fig_d("bw", "f") + theme(
        panel.grid=element_blank())
p2 <- p0 + 
    geom_col(position="identity", key_glyph="point") + 
    scale_x_continuous("# cells", limits=c(0, 1e4), n.breaks=6) +
    geom_text(
        aes(Inf, label=format(Freq, big.mark=",")),
        filter(df, ex == FALSE), hjust=1.1, size=2) +
    .thm_fig_d("bw", "f") + theme(
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank())
(p1+p2) + 
    plot_layout(nrow=1, guides="collect") &
    labs(y=NULL) & scale_fill_manual("excluded",
        values=c("slategray1", "slategray")) &
    coord_cartesian(expand=FALSE) & 
    theme(aspect.ratio=1)

library(arrow)
library(scuttle)
library(BiocParallel)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")
bp <- MulticoreParam(4)





pbs <- readRDS("outs/qbs.rds")
sce <- readRDS("outs/fil.rds")
ist <- readRDS("outs/lv1.rds")





# include epithelia in stromal compartment
ist$clust[ist$clust == "epi"] <- "str"
epi <- colnames(ist$profiles) == "epi"
colnames(ist$profiles)[epi] <- "str"


sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
sub <- sort(unique(ist$clust))
names(sub) <- sub <- setdiff(sub, "epi")
lapply(pbs, colnames); table(ist$clust)

$mye

$nkt
[1] "NK"   "Tcm"  "Tcn"  "Tem"  "Tex"  "Tfh"  "Thn"  "Tra"  "Treg"

$tum
[1] "tum.act" "tum.low" "tum.pro"



  mye   nkt   str   tum 
 7456  8522  8217 59983 






mx <- normalizeCounts(ist$profiles)
names(ks) <- ks <- unique(colnames(mx))
mx <- sapply(ks, \(k) rowMeans(mx[, k, drop=FALSE]))
sel <- lapply(ks, \(.) {
    my <- mx[, setdiff(ks, .)]
    fc <- apply(my, 2, \(x) mx[, .]/x)
    fc[!is.finite(fc)] <- NA
    fc <- rowMins(fc, na.rm=TRUE)
    fc <- fc[!is.na(fc) & is.finite(fc) & fc > 2]
    gs <- names(tail(sort(fc), 2e3))
})
sapply(ks, \(.) {
    se <- sce[, names(which(ist$clust == .))]
    gs <- intersect(rownames(se), sel[[.]])
    summary(tot <- colSums(assay(se)[gs, ]))
})

# exclude Ig-related features for tumor subclustering
sel$tum <- grepv("^IG(H|K|L)", sel$tum, invert=TRUE)
sapply(sel, length)

tum str mye nkt 
602 482 220 257 






jst <- bplapply(sub, \(.) {
    set.seed(260222)
    se <- sce[, names(which(ist$clust == .))]
    ex <- colSums(assay(se)[sel[[.]], ] > 0) < 10
    ns <- c(1e4, 2e4, 1e5)/ifelse(. == "tum", 2, 5)
    nk <- if (. == "mye") seq(2, 4) else if (. != "nkt") seq(3, 9) else 0
    ist <- .ist(se[, !ex], nk=nk, ns=ns, gs=sel[[.]], pbs=pbs[[.]])
    ks <- intersect(letters, unique(ist$clust))
    ks <- c(ks, sort(colnames(pbs[[.]])))
    ist$clust <- factor(ist$clust, ks)
    ist
}, BPPARAM=bp)







wrap_plots(lapply(names(jst), \(.) .plt_fp(jst[[.]], .)), nrow=1)

}) |> wrap_plots(nrow=1)

})

library(RANN)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cluster)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
source("code/_utils.R")





sce <- readRDS("outs/fil.rds")
ist <- readRDS("outs/lv1.rds")
jst <- readRDS("outs/lv2.rds")





sce$lv1 <- (kid <- ist$clust)[match(colnames(sce), names(kid))]
kid <- unlist(unname(lapply(jst, \(.) .$clust)))
idx <- match(colnames(sce), names(kid))
table(sce$lv2 <- kid[idx], exclude=NULL)


    BEC     epi     fib  FRCcts   FRCpv  FRCtcz     LEC    mCAF     AML      DC 
   1034     212     653     941     744    3753     945    2016    2943    1700 
 mac.pi  mono.c mono.nc     pDC     TAM     tum      NK  NK/ILC     Tcm     Tcn 
   1529    1276     213    1587     866   61871      42     422     197     747 
    Tex     Tfh     Tha     Thn      Tp    Treg 
   1969     921     310    3513     358    1071 






cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
names(id) <- id <- names(cs)
r <- 0.02; k <- 101
# get radial neighborhood
is <- lapply(id, \(sid) {
    sub <- sce[, cs[[sid]]]
    xy <- "Center(X|Y)_global_mm"
    xy <- grep(xy, names(colData(sub)))
    xy <- as.matrix(colData(sub)[xy])
    nn <- nn2(xy, searchtype="radius", r=r, k=k)
    is <- nn$nn.idx[, -1]; is[is == 0] <- NA; is
})



Code
n <- unlist(lapply(is, \(.) rowSums(!is.na(.))))
l <- sprintf("#cells in %sum radial neighborhood", r*1e3)
hist(n, breaks=seq(-.5, max(n)+.5), xlab="", ylab="",  main=l)
abline(v=quantile(n, c(.05, .95)), col="red", lw=2, lty=2)
abline(v=m <- mean(n), col="red", lw=2); m









[1] 13.55114






# quantify each neighborhood's
# subpopulation composition
fq <- lapply(id, \(.) {
    ks <- (se <- sce[, cs[[.]]])$lv2
    ks[is.na(ks)] <- "tum"
    mx <- matrix(ks[is[[.]]], nrow=ncol(se))
    mx[is.na(mx)] <- ""
    names(kt) <- kt <- unique(ks)
    ns <- sapply(kt, \(k) rowSums(mx == k))
    data.frame(
        prop.table(ns, 1),
        row.names=colnames(se))
}) |> bind_rows(); fq[is.na(fq)] <- 0





set.seed(251210)
km <- kmeans(fq, centers=k <- 10)$cluster
ns <- sprintf("%02d", seq_len(k))
ns <- factor(km, labels=paste0("N", ns))





sce$ctx <- ns[match(colnames(sce), names(ns))]
t(sapply(cs, \(.) table(ns[.]))); table(ns)

my <- as.matrix((mx <- pivot_wider(mu))[, -1])
names(ns) <- ns <- rownames(my) <- mx[[1]]
gs <- lapply(ns, \(i) {
    j <- setdiff(ns, i)
    fc <- my[i, ]/colMeans(my[j, ])
    names(tail(sort(fc), 40))

        scale_x_discrete(limits=.xo(my)) +

        .thm_fig_c("minimal") + theme(

.bin <- \(z, x, a=NULL, nx=10) {
    if (is.matrix(z)) {
        z <- SingleCellExperiment(assays=list(foo=z))
        a <- "foo"
    }
    xs <- cut(.q(x), 
        include.lowest=TRUE,
        breaks=seq(0, 1, l=nx))
    mu <- aggregateAcrossCells(z, ids=xs,
        use.assay.type=a, statistics="mean")
    df <- data.frame(x=mu$ids, t(assay(mu)), check.names=FALSE)
}

cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)

r <- 0.02; k <- 101
# get radial neighborhood
is <- lapply(id, \(sid) {
    sub <- sce[, cs[[sid]]]
    xy <- "Center(X|Y)_global_mm"
    xy <- grep(xy, names(colData(sub)))
    xy <- as.matrix(colData(sub)[xy])
    nn <- nn2(xy, searchtype="radius", r=r, k=k)
    is <- nn$nn.idx[, -1]; is[is == 0] <- NA; is
})

l <- sprintf("#cells in %sum radial neighborhood", r*1e3)

# quantify each neighborhood's
# subpopulation composition
fq <- lapply(id, \(.) {
    ks <- (se <- sce[, cs[[.]]])$lv2
    #ks[is.na(ks)] <- "tum"
    mx <- matrix(ks[is[[.]]], nrow=ncol(se))
    mx[is.na(mx)] <- ""
    names(kt) <- kt <- levels(sce$lv2)
    ns <- sapply(kt, \(k) rowSums(mx == k))
    data.frame(
        prop.table(ns, 1),
        row.names=colnames(se))
}) |> bind_rows(); fq[is.na(fq)] <- 0
colData(sce)$fqs <- fq[colnames(sce), ]








# get point pattern using per-core 
# convex hull as window of observation
xy <- grep("global_mm", names(cd <- colData(sce)))
cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
pp <- lapply(cs, \(.) {
    ow <- ripras(xy <- as.matrix(cd[., xy]))
    xy <- xy[which(cd$lv1[.] == "tum"), ]
    pp <- ppp(xy[,1], xy[,2], window=ow)
})
# visualize kernel density estimate

kd <- lapply(pp, density.ppp)
par(mfrow=c(4, 5), mar=c(1,0,0,0))
for (. in names(kd)) plot(kd[[.]], main=., col=pals::jet())












# estimate tumoral density at

fn <- lapply(pp, densityfun)
ds <- lapply(names(fn), \(.) {
    xy <- cd[cs[[.]], xy]
    fn[[.]](xy[,1], xy[,2], drop=FALSE)
})
is <- match(colnames(sce), unlist(cs))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), kde=unlist(ds)[is])

cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)

    ow <- ripras(xy <- as.matrix(cd[., xy]))

})

})

set.seed(260130)
sce <- logNormCounts(sce)
tbl <- modelGeneVar(sce)
sel <- getTopHVGs(tbl, n=2e3)
sel <- rownames(sce) %in% sel
rowData(sce)$sel <- sel
sce <- runPCA(sce, subset_row=sel)
sce <- runUMAP(sce, dimred="PCA", n_dimred=20)





set.seed(260131)
idx <- split(colnames(sce), sce$lv1)
names(ids) <- ids <- names(idx)
lys <- bplapply(ids, \(.) {
    sel <- rownames(jst[[.]]$profiles)
    sel <- rownames(sce) %in% sel
    rowData(sce)[[.]] <- sel
    sce <- runPCA(sce[, idx[[.]]], subset_row=sel)
    runUMAP(sce, dimred="PCA", n_dimred=10)
}, BPPARAM=bp)





# stash split reductions
for (a in c("PCA", "UMAP")) {
    b <- switch(a, PCA="PCB", "UMAQ")
    dr <- lapply(lys, reducedDim, a)
    dr <- do.call(rbind, dr)
    cs <- match(colnames(sce), rownames(dr))
    reducedDim(sce, b) <- dr[cs, ]
}
# stash feature selections
sel <- sapply(ids, \(.) rowData(lys[[.]])[[.]])
rowData(sce) <- cbind(rowData(sce), sel); sce

# get point pattern using per-core 
# convex hull as window of observation
xy <- grep("global_mm", names(cd <- colData(sce)))
cs <- split(colnames(sce), sce$sid)
pp <- lapply(cs, \(.) {
    ow <- ripras(xy <- as.matrix(cd[., xy]))
    xy <- xy[which(cd$lv1[.] == "tum"), ]
    pp <- ppp(xy[,1], xy[,2], window=ow)
})
# visualize kernel density estimate
# of tumoral density across cores
kd <- lapply(pp, density.ppp)
par(mfrow=c(4, 5), mar=c(1,0,0,0))
for (. in names(kd)) plot(kd[[.]], main=., col=pals::jet())












# estimate tumoral density at
# observed cellular coordinates
fn <- lapply(pp, densityfun)
ds <- lapply(names(fn), \(.) {
    xy <- cd[cs[[.]], xy]
    fn[[.]](xy[,1], xy[,2], drop=FALSE)
})
is <- match(colnames(sce), unlist(cs))
df <- data.frame(colData(sce), kde=unlist(ds)[is])
xs <- seq(min(ds <- .q(df$kde)), max(ds), l=26)
df$bin <- cut(ds, breaks=xs, include.lowest=TRUE)
sce$kde <- df$kde; sce$bin <- df$bin
hist(ds, n=100, 
    xlab="q-scaled tumoral density", 
    ylab="# cells", main="")
abline(v=xs, col="red")

.plt_hm <- \(df, gs, x, xo=TRUE, yo=TRUE, ax=TRUE) {
    # wrangling
    mu <- df |>
        group_by(!!!sym(x)) |>
        summarise(across(all_of(gs), mean))
    # scaling
    fd <- mu |>
        mutate(across(all_of(gs), .z)) |>
        pivot_longer(all_of(gs))
    # ordering
    mx <- pivot_wider(fd)
    my <- as.matrix(mx[, -1])
    rownames(my) <- seq(nrow(my))
    xo <- if (xo) scale_x_discrete(limits=mx[[1]][as.integer(.xo(my))])
    yo <- if (yo) scale_y_discrete(limits=.yo(my))
    # aesthetics
    ax <- if (ax) theme(
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1)) else
        theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
    # plotting
    ggplot(fd, aes(.data[[x]], name, fill=value)) +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
            "z-scaled\nmean score",
            colors=rev(pals::brewer.rdgy(9)),
            limits=c(-2.5,2.5), breaks=seq(-2,2,2)) +
        labs(y=NULL) + coord_equal(2/3, expand=FALSE) + 
        geom_tile() + xo + yo + .thm_fig_c("bw") + ax
}

cs <- match(unique(sce$sid), sce$sid)
cd <- data.frame(colData(sce)[cs, ])
cd <- cd[order(factor(cd$typ)), ]
cd <- cd[order(factor(cd$gid)), ]
cd$sid <- factor(cd$sid, cd$sid)
num <- c("MIPI", "LDH", "LDHNORML")
for (. in num) cd[[.]] <- as.numeric(cd[[.]])
cd <- cd[, c("typ", grepv("[a-z]id$", names(cd)), names(cd)[107:134])]
pal <- list(sid=.pal_sid, pid=.pal_pid, gid=.pal_gid, typ=.pal_typ)
aes <- list(
    theme_void(6),
    coord_equal(expand=FALSE),
    geom_tile(col="white", alpha=2/3),
    theme(plot.title=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, margin=margin(b=6))))
ps <- lapply(names(cd), \(.) {
    col <- if (. %in% names(pal)) {
        scale_fill_manual(values=pal[[.]])
    } else if (is.numeric(cd[[.]])) {
        cd[[.]] <- round(cd[[.]], 2)
        scale_fill_gradientn(colors=c("white", "red"))
    }
    ggplot(cd, aes(sid, 0, fill=.data[[.]])) + 
        aes + col + ggtitle(.) +
        geom_text(aes(label=.data[[.]]), size=1) 
})
ps[1] <- lapply(ps[1], `+`, list(theme(axis.text.y=element_text())))
wrap_plots(ps, 
    nrow=1, guides="collect") &
    theme(legend.position="none") &
    coord_flip()
